name: twins are a symmetric sibling edge, mirrored onto the other twin
description: The twin half of the four-daughters discrepancy: 'Tamsin and Quorra are identical twin girls' came back as an `attribute` (twinStatus) on Tamsin whose VALUE was the whole sentence — so Quorra carried nothing and the value rendered as prose instead of an edge. v10 teaches that a relationship between two named people is a `sibling` relationship edge (qualifier 'twin'), never a sentence-valued attribute; the pipeline then materializes the symmetric reciprocal on Quorra's stream. The model emits only the one directed edge. TOOL-PATH NOTE: both sibling facts asserted qualifier='twin' before the W3 re-point; the tool has no qualifier field, and unlike the ownership cases this qualifier did NOT name the object -- 'twin' is a genuine lost discriminator. Nothing collides on its absence (sibling is non-functional and keys on its object), so the inverse materialization this file exists for is unaffected.

steps.body: Tamsin and Quorra are identical twin girls.

facts.statement: Tamsin and Quorra are identical twin sisters.
